payload.title: Working with multiple records: `MultipleSeries` and `EnsembleSeries`
payload.description: This notebook introduces the `MultipleSeries` and `EnsembleSeries` objects for analyzing and visualizing multiple time series in paleoclimate studies. It demonstrates how to load and manipulate datasets using the LiPD format, create stackplots, and customize visualizations. The notebook also covers creating and visualizing ensemble series from NetCDF files, including plotting traces, envelopes, and performing spectral analysis. The focus is on using the `pyleoclim` library to handle complex workflows with ease.
